enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Remain still. Breathe deeply.
Open eyes. Sit up. Stretch arms overhead. Yawn. Rub eyes. Swing legs out of bed. Stand up. Stretch back. Bend forward to touch toes. Stand upright. Walk to bathroom door.
Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Exit bathroom.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator and take out eggs, milk, and butter. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet and take out bowl and pan. Close cabinet. Crack eggs into bowl and beat with fork. Turn on induction cooker and place pan on cooker. Pour eggs into pan and stir. Turn off cooker and place eggs on plate. Place bread in toaster and press lever. Remove toast and spread butter on it. Pour milk into glass. Sit at table. Eat breakfast and drink milk. Pick up plate and glass. Rinse plate and glass. Place in dishwasher. Turn off light. Exit kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open closet. Take out shirt, pants, socks, and shoes. Close closet. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Stand in front of mirror. Comb hair. Apply deodorant. Pick up bag and check contents. Put on watch. Pick up phone and put in pocket. Walk to door.

Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Check phone for time. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Read messages. Put phone away. Bus stops. Get off bus. Walk to office building. Enter building.

Enter office. Greet colleagues. Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open calendar. Check schedule. Attend meeting. Take notes. Discuss projects. Return to desk. Make phone calls. Write reports. Print documents. File documents. Talk to coworker. Drink water. Use computer.

Leave office. Walk to cafeteria. Wait in line. Buy lunch. Pay for food. Pick up utensils. Find table. Sit down. Open container. Eat lunch. Talk to colleague. Drink water. Wipe mouth. Clean up. Throw trash. Walk back to office.

Enter office. Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Attend meeting. Take notes. Discuss projects. Make phone calls. Write reports. Use computer. Print documents. File documents. Talk to coworker. Drink water.
Leave office. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Read messages. Put phone away. Get off bus. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter house.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator and take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet and take out pot and pan. Close cabinet. Wash and chop vegetables. Turn on stove and place pot on it. Add water and boil. Add vegetables and stir. Turn off stove and place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner and drink water. Pick up plate and utensils. Rinse and place in dishwasher. Turn off light and exit kitchen.

Enter living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Adjust volume. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Get snack. Return to couch. Sit down. Continue watching TV. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

Sit at desk. Open laptop. Turn on computer. Enter password. Open browser. Check email. Open social media. Scroll. Like posts. Comment. Open document. Type. Save document. Close browser. Open game. Play game. Close game. Shut down computer. Close laptop. Stand up.

Enter bedroom. Turn on lamp. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Read more. Turn page. Put down book. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Pick up book. Continue reading. Close book. Place book on nightstand. Turn off lamp. Lie down.

Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Spit. Rinse mouth. Put down toothbrush. Wash face. Dry face with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Exit bathroom.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Remain still. Breathe deeply.
